question: E79 Amendment 1: job 51117 read A (the clean term alone) better than B on all four numbers once Gamma reads the student. Does the own-mask read have teeth, or is it empty: Gamma opens many more subcomponents on the student, the read passes anything near FT, or it holds on maths only?
rules: experiments/qwen_masked_read/rules_amend1.py; run against P's clean under A's read, a zero Sigma-g denominator, NaN and ties on the bands in tests/test_qwen_masked_read.py before filing

states.W0, A, B, L: As job 51117: E76's bf16 offsets from qwen_masked_teacher/results/large/
states.C: E76's control student, qwen_masked_teacher/results/large/C_offsets.safetensors, trained towards W0 plus a random change; read against FT clean like every other state, its own teacher is not read

P.what: A's saved offsets with dU and dV permuted together within each site over the 200 cut columns (`alive`), one torch.randperm per site in SITES order, CPU generator; then both scaled by one number per site so that the change's squared size equals A's
P.plan_change: The plan and the brief ask for a permutation with the same squared size per site. E76's squared size is that of the change, dV (U + dU) + V dU, and U and V do not move with the permutation, so a permutation alone keeps the offsets' size and not the change's. Smallest fix: one scale per site, solved exactly, with the change's squared size per site asserted equal to A's within 1e-3 relative. What the permutation alone gave, over A's, and the scales are in amend1.json under P

rows: M and W as job 51117: E76's 8 reading rows (maths 0-7), and FineWeb rows 32-39, 256 tokens
masks: Gamma on the state's own forward: weights W0 + change, the alive columns of the components moved; g in bf16; m = g + (1 - g) u, d ~ U(0, 1), a fresh generator per row set at draw d1 (seed 76200); W0 also at d2 (seed 79200), for the bands; all 196 sites masked; readings in full fp32

a.what: forward KL(FT clean || state own masked), reverse, top-token agreement, entropy

W0.note: W0's own masks are E76's g: these are job 51117's frozen-mask reads at d1

a.blind_to: forward rewards softness; whether the masks are nearly open, which is number c

b.what: forward KL(state clean || state own masked), the state's own faithfulness

W0.W: measured, under W0's forward against FT there, 0.1313

b.blind_to: how far the state's clean is from FT, which is a and d

c.what: Sigma-g per position over all 196 sites and all columns, and the count of g > 0.5 per position, mean over rows and positions; each with its ratio to W0's on the same rows

expected.others: measured; above 1.5 on A, M is the opens rule

c.blind_to: which subcomponents open; a mask's effect on the output

d.what: forward KL(FT clean || state clean), for P and C; the others' read too, since the job computes the forward anyway

expected.P: measured; well over 0.078 if P is wrong
expected.C: measured; near W0's, since C's change is small and not towards FT

control.what: First and alone, W0 and then A: number a forward under own masks on M at d1 reproduces job 51117's within 1e-3 (results/read.json, reads.<state>.M.own), or results/stopped_amend1.json and exit 1

rule.on: A's reads, row set M unless stated, draw d1, all positions
rule.band: W0's difference between d1 and d2, on the same number and rows, measured in this job; the other states have d1 alone. Sigma-g and the count have no draw and no band
rule.opens: A's Sigma-g ratio or count ratio strictly above 1.5: 'opens'; a NaN with no other above: 'unread'; else 'does not open'. A zero W0 denominator reads NaN
rule.teeth: For P and then C, own = number a forward, clean = number d, A = A's number a forward, b = the band on M. NaN anywhere: 'unread'. clean < A: 'not wrong enough', as read. own - b < 3 A: 'no teeth'. own + b > 3 clean: 'over 3 x its clean', as read. Else 'teeth'. The plan's 'above P's clean by no more than a factor 3' bounds own from above only, so own below clean can read 'teeth', and own and clean are reported either way. 'Not wrong enough' could not read 'teeth' anyway: clean < A makes 3 A <= own and own <= 3 clean impossible
rule.faithful: A's number b + b's band <= 2 x W0's number b on the same rows, on M and on W each. W0's at zero, or NaN: 'unread'
rule.pass: 'does not open', 'teeth' for both P and C, 'faithful' on both M and W: the own-mask read is a test A passes. Anything else is reported as read
rule.ties: Numbers compared rounded to 9 places. A tie reads as the inequality's closed side: exactly 3 x A beyond the band, exactly 3 x clean beyond the band and exactly 2 x W0 beyond the band all hold; exactly 1.5 does not open; clean exactly at A is not under it

opens.why: the fall from 1.33 to 0.078 for so small a change wants explaining

what_each_result_does.passes all three: The clean term alone is the leading candidate map, at less than the update's size, with no masked term; this goes in a headline claim, so it gets an independent check before the user is asked for the next step
what_each_result_does.opens: Masks read through Gamma on the student are not comparable with W0's; B and A are then both read under frozen masks, as E76 and this plan did
what_each_result_does.no teeth: The own-mask read has no use for D1; the clean table stands alone

not_run: A second draw on any state but W0; P and C on the frozen masks; any other permutation seed; P without the scale (what the permutation alone gives is in amend1.json as a size only, not read)
